decisions.reason: Requiring template delivery to conclude the project does not change the separate digital PDF deliverable or its Heyzine handoff.
The template handoff condition does not change the digital magazine launch deadline or required launch state.
Template delivery as a project-conclusion condition does not add, remove, or alter required issue content.
The source decision concerns delivery of the editable template and does not modify article-ending whitespace or fill-content rules.
The template handoff condition does not alter the magazine's visual style, branding reference, or color-use rules.
Requiring template delivery does not change the current issue's pagination, flat-plan basis, or article placement rules.
The source decision does not change the requirement to enhance publication image quality when needed.
Template delivery as a condition for concluding the project does not change the table-of-contents completion or page-number requirements.
The template handoff condition does not alter author-name, author-photo, coverage, or source requirements.
The source decision does not change the selected article typeface, weight treatment, or readability requirement.
Requiring delivery of the template does not modify the rules for breaking up long article text or requesting additional visuals.
The template handoff condition does not change the requirement that advertisements render clearly.
